description: Source code for Goteo's ProjectsApiController class, providing API endpoints for project listing, detail retrieval, property updates, image management, and related project operations within the Goteo crowdfunding platform.

classes.name: ProjectsApiController
classes.description: Controller class providing API endpoints for project management, including listing, detail retrieval, property updates, image handling, and project-specific operations.

methods.name: projectsAction
methods.description: Returns a list of projects with filtering, pagination, and status options.

methods.name: getSafeProject
methods.description: Retrieves project data with security checks, returning only accessible project info.

methods.name: projectAction
methods.description: Returns detailed information about a specific project.

methods.name: projectPropertyAction
methods.description: Gets or updates a specific property of a project via PUT method.

methods.name: projectUpdatesPropertyAction
methods.description: Gets or updates a property of a project update (blog post) via PUT method.

methods.name: validateProject
methods.description: Validates user permissions and project state before modification.

methods.name: projectUploadImagesAction
methods.description: Handles image uploads for projects, with optional gallery updates.

methods.name: projectDeleteImagesAction
methods.description: Deletes an image from a project.

methods.name: projectDefaultImagesAction
methods.description: Sets a default image for a project.

methods.name: projectReorderImagesAction
methods.description: Reorders images within a project's gallery sections.

methods.name: projectMaterialsAction
methods.description: Manages project materials and rewards, including creation and URL updates.

methods.name: projectInvestsFulfilledAction
methods.description: Sets or retrieves the fulfilled status of an investment in a project.

methods.name: projectInvestsCSVAction
methods.description: Exports project investments data as CSV.

methods.name: projectDeleteSupportMsgAction
methods.description: Deletes a support message related to an investment.

methods.name: projectsFootprintsOrSDGs
methods.description: Retrieves projects filtered by footprints or SDGs, with different view options.

methods.name: getListProjectViewResponse
methods.description: Prepares project list view response with HTML rendering.

methods.name: getMosaicViewResponse
methods.description: Prepares mosaic view response with HTML rendering.

methods.name: getJsonViewResponse
methods.description: Prepares JSON response with project data for map or list views.
